title: 032 - Responsive Columns
prompt: Fix the bug so the program print 3 columns for a width of 900 and prints exactly `3`. Keep the sample data and do not add extra output.
brokenCode:
<?php

function responsiveColumns(array $values): int
{
    return intdiv(array_sum($values), count($values) - 1);
}
solutionCode:
<?php

function responsiveColumns(array $values): int
{
    return intdiv(array_sum($values), count($values));
}
hint: The top breakpoint should include 900 itself.
explanation: The breakpoint comparison excludes the exact boundary. Using an inclusive comparison fixes the column count.
